prompt:
Write a portfolio case study in Markdown for the freelancer Tobias Reyne (Full-stack developer - React, Next.js, Node.js and Postgres).

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Clinic patient portal
client: confidential
client_industry: healthcare
start: 2024-09
end: 2025-01
engagement: hourly
stack:
- Next.js
- NestJS
- PostgreSQL
- Prisma
- Twilio
implied_skills:
- audit logging
built: A portal for booking, lab results and SMS reminders, with every record view
  written to an audit trail.
metrics:
- 11k patients registered
- no-shows down 18% after reminders

Requirements:
- 300 to 450 words, first person, a short title line starting with "# ".
- Loosely cover the client's problem, what was built, and the results. Emphasis: how the client's team works now.
- Include one short code or config snippet (5 to 15 lines) in a fenced block that fits the stack.
- Refer to the client as "a client in healthcare (name withheld)".
- Never use these words or phrases: "audit logging". Describe the work so a reader can infer them.
